blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: ＳＦＣにあったメタルマックス２のＤＳ版大幅リメイク。筆者はＳＦＣ版未プレイで、序盤をちょっと見ただけ。
blocks.translation: A heavily remade DS version of Metal Max 2, originally released on the SFC. I have not played the SFC version and only took a brief look at the opening section.

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ時代はそこそこ有名タイトルだったと記憶しているけれど、リローデッドはその１／５程度しか売れてない模様。評判はよいし、完成度は素晴らしいのでもっと売れてもよさげ。
blocks.translation: I remember it being a moderately well-known title during the SFC era, but Reloaded apparently sold only about one-fifth as many copies. It has a good reputation and is wonderfully polished, so it deserves to have sold more.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: 悪の組織『バイアス・グラップラー』に母親代わりの女性を殺された主人公は復讐の旅へ出る。
blocks.translation: The protagonist, whose mother figure was killed by the evil organization Bias Grappler, sets out on a journey of revenge.

blocks.source: ……というのがあらすじだが、自由度は高い。
blocks.translation: That is the basic premise, but the game offers a great deal of freedom.

blocks.source: クエスト（サブイベント）はとてつもなく豊富で、よくある無味乾燥なお使いばかりではなく、イベント内容も多岐に渡る。
blocks.translation: Quests (side events) are incredibly plentiful, and instead of consisting only of the usual bland errands, they cover a wide variety of events.

blocks.source: 僕の場合、それなりにサブイベントもやってクリアまで４２時間だった。
blocks.translation: In my case, I completed a fair number of side events and finished the game in 42 hours.

blocks.source: 全体的に行動を成約する要素が少ないのが好印象。
blocks.translation: I liked that there are generally few elements restricting your actions.

blocks.source: 本編の内容は絞られており、ごく一部のダンジョン＆ボスが必須なだけ。プレイヤーの行動範囲は広く、色んな場所にどんどん行ける。
blocks.translation: The main story is streamlined, with only a small number of dungeons and bosses being mandatory. Players have a wide range of movement and can freely go to all sorts of places.

blocks.source: 四天王を始めとして、必須イベントのボスは個性豊かで手強い。サブイベントで強化したキャラクターや戦車の力を存分に発揮できる。
blocks.translation: The bosses in mandatory events, including the Four Heavenly Kings, are distinctive and formidable. You can make full use of characters and tanks strengthened through side events.

blocks.source: この種のクエスト系で、まともに面白いものを久々に見たような気がする。こういう自由度の高さは個人的にも見習いたいところ。
blocks.translation: I feel like it has been a long time since I saw a genuinely fun quest-based game of this kind. This level of freedom is something I would personally like to learn from.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ版とは別物に近いレベルで追加要素がある模様。元祖、お尋ね者システム（賞金首）を搭載したシリーズだけど、お尋ね者の数はＳＦＣ版の二倍とのこと。
blocks.translation: Apparently, it has enough additional content to make it almost a different game from the SFC version. It is a series that pioneered the Wanted system (bounties), and it reportedly has twice as many wanted criminals as the SFC version.

blocks.source: このシリーズの最大の特徴は『戦車』という一点に尽きる。人間と戦車を切り替えながら、戦っていくことになる。戦車に武器を積んだり、改造したりとカスタマイズ性は高い。
blocks.translation: The defining feature of this series can be summed up in one word: “tanks.” You fight by switching between humans and tanks. The customization options are extensive, allowing you to equip tanks with weapons and modify them.

blocks.source: ちなみに、戦車と書いたけれどバイクなども存在する。作中では『クルマ』として総称されている、
blocks.translation: Incidentally, although I have called them tanks, motorcycles and other vehicles also exist. In the game, they are collectively referred to as “cars,”

blocks.source: 戦闘はテンポよく進む。オプションでスピードを変えられるけれど、初期設定でもかなり速い。
blocks.translation: Battles move along at a brisk pace. You can change the speed in the options, but it is already quite fast at the default setting.

blocks.source: お尋ね者を始めとした強敵との戦いが熱い。玉砕覚悟で格上の敵を狙うか、確実に勝てそうな相手を選ぶかはプレイヤー次第。戦闘バランスは大味なところもあるのだけど、その分、ギチギチに制約されることもなく、自由度につながっているとも言えそう。
blocks.translation: Battles against powerful enemies, including wanted criminals, are exciting. It is up to the player whether to risk everything by taking on a stronger enemy or choose an opponent they are sure to beat. The battle balance can be rather rough around the edges, but that also means you are not tightly constrained, which could be said to contribute to the game’s freedom.

blocks.source: 序盤のゲームバランスは良好。ただ、中盤以降はアイテムの過剰入手が気になってくる。『敵のドロップ』『イベント報酬』『宝箱』『お店』など色んなところでアイテムが手に入るので中身が頻繁にかぶる。「この装備前も手に入れたな」「既に持ってる装備のほうが強いな」みたいなのが多くなってくる。
blocks.translation: The game balance is good early on. However, from the middle of the game onward, the excessive acquisition of items starts to become noticeable. Items can be obtained in many places, such as enemy drops, event rewards, treasure chests, and shops, so you frequently end up with duplicates. You start seeing a lot of situations like, “I got this equipment before,” and “The equipment I already have is stronger.”

blocks.source: 同じような理由で序盤は金欠だったのだけど、中盤から意外と金が余った。賞金首を倒したり、アイテムを売ったりで儲ける手段も非常に多いため。
blocks.translation: For similar reasons, I was short on money early on, but from the middle of the game onward I unexpectedly had money to spare. There are also many ways to make money, such as defeating wanted criminals and selling items.

blocks.source: 強いボスも多いけれど、簡単に経験値を稼ぐ手段があるため、そんなに困らないはず。特に亀（スローウォーカー）は簡単に倒せるわりにやたら経験値が高い。はぐれメタル的なポジションだと思うけれど、こんな簡単でいいんですかね？
blocks.translation: There are many tough bosses, but you should not have too much trouble because there are easy ways to farm experience. Turtles (Slow Walkers) in particular give absurdly high experience for how easy they are to defeat. I think they fill a role similar to Metal Slimes, but is it really okay for them to be this easy?

blocks.source: システムの複雑さゆえに、操作周りは結構煩雑。致命的な部分はないのだけど、細かいところで手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: The controls are fairly cumbersome due to the complexity of the systems. There are no fatal issues, but minor tasks can be rather time-consuming.

blocks.source: 町中を移動するのに、クルマのマメな乗り降りが必要。
blocks.translation: You need to frequently get in and out of your car to move around towns.

blocks.source: 全滅時の蘇生やクルマの回収は一人（一台）ずつ。
blocks.translation: When your party is wiped out, reviving characters and recovering cars must be done one person (one vehicle) at a time.

blocks.source: 昔のゲームのように何かと細かい確認メッセージが表示される。しかし、システムは今時のゲームのように複雑で手間がかかる。
blocks.translation: Like in old games, various small confirmation messages appear frequently. However, the systems are as complex and cumbersome as those in modern games.

blocks.source: クルマ改造のルールが複雑。特にシャシー改造。
blocks.translation: The rules for modifying cars are complicated, especially chassis modifications.

blocks.source: 一番気になったのはクルマの重量制限。装備が重量制限を超えた場合、タイル（ＨＰに相当）を外さなくてはならない。この調整が結構手間。
blocks.translation: What concerned me most was the cars’ weight limit. If the equipment exceeds the weight limit, you have to remove tiles (equivalent to HP). Adjusting this is quite a hassle.

blocks.source: ……と思ったら、牽引車に荷物を持たせれば重量制限は関係なくなるので解決。……って、牽引車だからって重量を無視できるというのは、理屈としておかしくないか？ いえ便利なんで結構ですが。
blocks.translation: …Or so I thought, but having a tow vehicle carry the cargo makes the weight limit irrelevant, solving the problem. …But isn’t it illogical that being a tow vehicle allows you to ignore the weight? Well, it is convenient, so I cannot really complain.

blocks.source: 僕は気づいたからよかったけど、この方法に気付かない人は、結構イラつくんじゃないかなあ。
blocks.translation: I was glad that I figured it out, but people who do not discover this method are probably going to get pretty frustrated.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 元々はＳＦＣ初期の作品で、キャラグラが寂しい感じだった。なんせ、１６×１６のファミコン並サイズだったので。
blocks.translation: The original was an early SFC title, and its character graphics felt rather sparse. After all, they were only 16×16 pixels, about the size of NES graphics.

blocks.source: そのキャラグラもリローデッドになって、随分と綺麗になった。イラストも各職業ごとに男女があってよいと思う。
blocks.translation: Those character graphics have become considerably prettier in Reloaded. I also think it is good that there are male and female illustrations for each class.

blocks.source: バンバン撃ち合う戦闘も爽快。敵がアニメーションをするのも良。
blocks.translation: The rapid-fire battles are exhilarating as well. It is also nice that the enemies are animated.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: ＳＦＣ時代から評判だった賞金首戦が人気。
blocks.translation: The bounty hunter battles, which had been well regarded since the SFC era, are popular.

blocks.source: 四天王戦の曲は追加曲だそうで。
blocks.translation: Apparently, the music for the Four Heavenly Kings battles was newly added.
